protocol.holdout: hide-and-recover: whole 8-connected fault components touching a quadrant fold or its 1.5 km collar are hidden everywhere; visible catalogue masked pixel-exactly before credit/FP; pooled DTI alpha=0.2 beta=0.8, 300 m triangular kernel
protocol.catalogue_use: WDP-36 detector is unsupervised and reads NO catalogue-derived feature. The catalogue is used only for (a) holdout truth/visible definitions and (b) the d>2px dot-exclusion mask (fold-visible catalogue in holdout; full catalogue at deployment). The visible-only rule is therefore satisfied by construction.
protocol.emission: gemsdoe36.submodular_emit.emit_submodular_cover (exact 25-offset Euclidean 300 m CELF cover), eligible = valid & (distance to visible catalogue > 2.0 px)
protocol.score_labels: Every number labelled HOLDOUT-DTI (evaluator version, n withheld positives, 95% CI) or ORGANIZER-CONFIRMED (portal receipt). Projections are never written as scores.

bands.10_deq_n100a15: Seismic distance parameter per band tags (EXP-3, sign-flipped)

bands_excluded_with_reason.06_tc: Excluded: band tags claim tilt/total-curvature but repo forensics measured Spearman 0.999886 vs radiometric total count (IR-36-ATVR-02); mislabelled channel not trusted in this lane.
bands_excluded_with_reason.11_iso_grav_anom_vg_and_18_iso_grav_anom: Excluded: repo forensics show signed directional derivatives, not magnitude/vertical derivatives (IR-36-ATVR-03); WDP-36 computes its own spectral derivatives from band 13.
bands_excluded_with_reason.topography_lidar_hydrothermal_radiometri: Excluded by lane design: ATVR-36 / H36-CTRB / H36-GPS already exploit scarp/topo/hydrothermal evidence; WDP-36 must stay decorrelated (basin-interior buried structures) to satisfy the parallel-run lane rule.

forbidden: Any prior submission raster pixel (registry rasters are comparison-only, never inputs)
SGMC derived faults raster and any label-derived CSV column (e.g. dist_known_fault_px)
Any catalogue-distance, catalogue-density or continuation feature

detector_definition.upward_continuation: For F in {band14 tmi, band13 iso_grav_anom}: replace sentinel (-3.4028235e+38) / non-finite / outside-footprint cells with the footprint median, demean over the full grid, rFFT, multiply by exp(-|k|*h) for h in {0, 200, 400, 800} m with |k| = 2*pi*sqrt(fx^2+fy^2), f from fftfreq with d=100 m. THDR_h = sqrt((dF_h/dx)^2 + (dF_h/dy)^2) from spectral derivatives (i*kx, i*ky) of the same continued spectrum.
detector_definition.rank_normalisation: Each THDR_h converted to footprint percentile ranks r_h in [0,1] (average handling by stable argsort order; outside footprint = 0).
detector_definition.persistence_per_field: P_F = (prod_h (r_h + 1e-6))^(1/4): geometric mean across continuation heights. Deep (basement fault) edges stay strong at all heights; shallow volcanic/cultural edges and 200-400 m flight-line striping (GeoDAWN azimuth 90 deg lines) decay with h and are suppressed.
detector_definition.strain_ridge: For each of bands 04/07/08: footprint-median fill, Gaussian smooth sigma=1.5 px, gradient magnitude via numpy.gradient, footprint percentile rank. STRAIN = percentile rank of the mean of the three ranks.
detector_definition.seismic_composite: SEIS_RAW = 0.5*rank(band16) + 0.5*rank(-band10) over footprint, Gaussian smooth sigma=2.0 px, SEIS = percentile rank of smoothed composite.
detector_definition.ablation_control_A0: Single-scale worms: A0 = percentile rank of 0.5*r_0(tmi) + 0.5*r_0(grav) using only h=0. Isolates the value of persistence. A0 is a frozen control, not one of the 3 experiments (same convention as ATVR-36 C0/B1 controls).
detector_definition.winner_rule: Highest pooled HOLDOUT-DTI among EXP-1..3 becomes the deployment surface; all three numbers are reported regardless.

gates_fail_closed.G1_leakage_canary: SegmentHoldout.canary on every component + fused surface; pass iff two-polarity AUC <= 0.90 for all (pooled and per-fold as implemented by the template).
gates_fail_closed.G2_holdout_promotion: Pass iff winning EXP pooled HOLDOUT-DTI > 0.14876 (recorded group pooled best) AND compare_paired vs A0 favours the winner (point delta > 0; CI reported). Repo B0 = 0.13375 also reported. Both bars are HOLDOUT-DTI on gems-segment-pooled-v1 from prior run cards, not organizer scores.
gates_fail_closed.G3_uniqueness: Pass iff pre-placement surface |Spearman rho| <= 0.90 AND final-dot 3 px overlap <= 0.70 against competing registry rasters (focus-9 and expanded registry reported separately; dense area-blankets flagged, never hidden). Overlap vs GEMSDOE32 0.2778 champion and vs ATVR-36/H36-CTRB/H36-GPS reported individually.
gates_fail_closed.G4_format: Pass iff gems.submission.check_variants format_valid AND strict whole-array finite [0,1] for the primary zeros GeoTIFF AND CRS/shape/transform match template AND exactly 37654 dots AND 0 dots within 2.0 px of the full catalogue.
gates_fail_closed.verdict: promote iff G1+G2+G3+G4 all pass; otherwise negative = DO NOT SUBMIT (hold weekly slot), DOWNLOAD: YES for research/ensemble. No human inspector step exists in the gate.

named_non_fault_mimics: Deep non-fault basement lithologic contacts (e.g. pluton margins) also persist under upward continuation; persistence alone cannot prove faulting.
Smooth regional strain gradients and volcanic inflation can mimic strain-rate discontinuities.
Diffuse aftershock clouds and geothermal-plant induced seismicity can mimic blind-fault seismic lineaments.
Residual GeoDAWN flight-line levelling stripes (E-W, azimuth 90 deg) are short-wavelength; persistence suppresses but does not mathematically eliminate them.
known_holdout_limitation_stated_in_advan: Hide-and-recover withholds catalogue-style (mostly surface-expressed) faults. A buried-fault detector can therefore be penalised by the holdout even if it finds genuine blind structures. The gate is still applied fail-closed: the Final Prize Round expanded-label rescore (official page 967) is noted as context for a separate human selector, never as a reason to override a negative holdout in this lane.
